description: Depreciation and amortization, by period. Depreciation and amortization (dollars): Depreciation and amortization, normally from the cash flow statement. Default: every period in the latest record (up to three fiscal years, the latest quarter and its prior-year comparative, year to date, trailing twelve months); `period` narrows to one fiscal year or quarter, searching older records, and period='all' returns the full history. Each value carries its exact amount, the field it was read from, its dates, accession and form, and a sec.gov link to the line printing it. Field names differ by company: Depreciation and amortization is read from depreciation_and_amortization, depreciation_amortization_and_depletion, depreciation_depletion_and_amortization, depreciation_amortization_and_accretion, depreciation_and_amortization_expense, depreciation_amortization_and_other, depreciation_and_amortization_net, depreciation, operating_activities.depreciation_and_amortization. The company's own headline field is tried first, then these names in order; nothing is estimated or summed. Look-alike fields come back under `related`; if none match, the response says so and lists similar fields. Actual dollars (not millions), shares split-adjusted, a foreign issuer's figures in US dollars.

period.description: Fiscal period: 'FY2025', 'Q2 FY2027' (also 'FY27Q2', 'Q2 2027'), 'latest', 'latest quarter', 'latest annual', 'ttm', 'ytd', 'annual', 'quarterly', 'all', or a period-end date. The company's own fiscal years. Omit for every period in the latest record. A period earlier than the data held returns that the data does not go back that far, and what is held.

ticker.description: Ticker symbol, case-insensitive. Examples: NVDA, brk-b, BRK.B.
